name: John Thune

lean.basis: Republican senator since 2005 and Senate Republican leader since 2025.

sources.title: John Thune — Wikipedia

current_role: Senate Majority Leader (since January 2025; until January 2027)
summary: John Thune, a South Dakota Republican senator since 2005, became Senate majority leader in January 2025. After Democrats won the Senate in November 2026, he said he would run to stay on as Republican leader in the minority, with the conference vote set for November 10.
